title: ctenitis bivestita
intro: Ctenitis bivestita, commonly known as the Two-horned Tree Fern, is a species of fern native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis bivestita are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
